Address: C 210 P, Phase 8B, Industrial Area, Sector 74, Sahibzada Ajit Singh Nagar, Punjab 160055

We are seeking a highly skilled Sr. Website UI/UX Designer and Developer with expertise in creating, customizing, and maintaining websites on WordPress, Shopify, and Kajabi. Website Design and Customization:

Set up and customize Kajabi sites for course creators and coaches, optimizing sales funnels, membership portals, and user experiences.
Website Optimization:
Ensure websites are optimized for speed, SEO, and performance, across all platforms.

Version Control & Collaboration:
Use Git for version control and collaborative development across all projects.
Manage deployments and updates across WordPress, Shopify, and Kajabi websites.

Front-End Expertise:
Strong proficiency in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and responsive design principles.
Experience with JavaScript frameworks or libraries like jQuery for dynamic features.
WordPress Development:
Advanced experience in WordPress theme and plugin development using PHP.
Extensive experience with Advanced Custom Fields (ACF) for custom content management in WordPress.
Shopify Development:
Expertise in Shopify theme customization and building custom features using Liquid.
Familiarity with Shopify APIs for integrating third-party apps and services.
Kajabi Development:
Strong experience working with Kajabi for designing and customizing membership, course, and sales funnel pages.
Ability to use Liquid for advanced customizations in Kajabi to enhance functionality and design.
E-commerce Expertise:
Proficiency in setting up and customizing e-commerce stores on Shopify and WooCommerce.
Experience with Kajabi for building and optimizing online courses, memberships, and sales funnels.
API & REST API Integration:
Experience with API integration across platforms (WordPress, Shopify, Kajabi) for custom functionality.
Performance & SEO Optimization:
Proven track record of optimizing website speed, performance, and SEO best practices across platforms.
Version Control:
Familiarity with Git for version control and collaborative project workflows.

3+ years of experience in WordPress, Shopify, and Kajabi development.
